title: Sweep model depth (DEPTH=8 -> 10)
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 10 (model_dim goes 512->640, 4->5 heads), everything else unchanged.
reflection: Clear improvement: val_bpb 1.014027 -> 1.002279 (~1.2% relative reduction) just from going deeper/wider at fixed time budget. This suggests DEPTH=8 was not tuned optimally for this 5-min time budget and the depth/width axis has more room. Worth a follow-up sweep (e.g. DEPTH=12, 14) to find where returns diminish or reverse (deeper models take longer per step, so at some point step-count losses outweigh capacity gains).
